hinweis: Erzeugt von scripts/karten.mjs aus data/techniken.json und data/techniken.en.json. Nicht von Hand bearbeiten.

guertel.name: White belt
guertel.kannst_du: Write prompts with Goal, Context, Source and Expectations, and get interviewed before you write.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now say what you want and let yourself be interviewed.

guertel.name: Yellow belt
guertel.kannst_du: Request and check drafts so that errors show up before you send them.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now check before you send.

guertel.name: Orange belt
guertel.kannst_du: Analyze files and web sources, with a source location for every statement.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now read tracks, each with its source location.

guertel.name: Green belt
guertel.kannst_du: Instruct and check your first own agent.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now have your first student.

guertel.name: Blue belt
guertel.kannst_du: Give an agent steps and define when it hands over to a person.
guertel.erreicht_satz: Your agent now knows its path and its limits.

guertel.name: Brown belt
guertel.kannst_du: Pass data on cleanly and estimate an agent's consumption before it gets expensive.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now know what your agent consumes before it runs.

guertel.name: Black belt
guertel.kannst_du: Monitor agents in production and shut them down in time.
guertel.erreicht_satz: You now keep watch, even when nobody is working on the agent.
